message.content:
Elena turns into a **vampire in Season 4, Episode 1, “Growing Pains”** of *The Vampire Diaries*.[1][3]

Her transition begins at the end of Season 3, when she dies with vampire blood in her system, and she fully completes the change in that Season 4 premiere by feeding on human blood.[1][4]

If you want, I can also tell you **when she becomes human again**.
